title: Renewal risk heatmap & intervention playbook
content:
Purpose:
This is a working playbook for quickly assessing renewal risk using a compact heatmap and executing targeted intervention plays. Intended for CSMs, renewal managers, Solutions Eng, and execs during high-risk escalations. Draft — expects feedback on thresholds and remediation options.

Overview: heatmap + tiered actions
- Single-page heatmap combines 6 signals into a 0-100 risk score per account. Visual: 4x4 grid (x axis: usage trajectory, feature adoption; y axis: NPS change, support velocity). Color bands: green (0-24), amber (25-49), orange (50-74), red (75-100).

Signals (inputs to score) and suggested weights (editable):
- MAU trend (30%) — last 90d vs previous 90d, normalized by seat growth
- Feature adoption (20%) — percent of purchased product areas in active use
- Support volume / severity (15%) — tickets per seat + sev1 occurrences
- NPS / CSAT delta (15%) — 90d rolling change vs baseline
- Contract health (10%) — usage vs committed units, overage patterns
- Exec engagement (10%) — last 60d contact with sponsor or champion (scaled)
Formula (example): risk = 100 - (weighted-normalized-scores) then clipped 0-100.

Risk tiers and playbook summary (fast-reference):
- Green (0-24): Monitor — automated nudges, monthly check-ins. Low-touch renewal outreach at T-90.
- Amber (25-49): CSM-led re-engage — 1:1 health call, tailored QBR, adoption plan. T-90 -> T-45 cadence.
- Orange (50-74): High priority — Renewal manager + SE technical audit, ROI refresh, feature enablement, target 30/14/7 cadence. Consider commercial sweetener if adoption blockers persist.
- Red (75-100): Executive escalation — form a cross-functional task force (CS, Sales AE, SE, Product), immediate Exec-to-Exec meeting, offer concrete remediation (SLA credits, timeline for fixes, temporary price protection), propose pilot-extension or contract amendment.

Detailed actions per tier:
Green:
- Automated monthly usage digest sent from Console.
- Add to "Healthy renewals" QBR cohort.
- No discounting; standard renewal cadence.

Amber:
- CSM play: 30-min health check focused on top 3 friction points. Prep packet: adoption dashboard, support trends, top 2 success metrics.
- If Feature gap found: schedule 2-week enablement workshop with SE.
- Escalate to Renewal manager at T-45 if no forward progress.

Orange (sample runbook):
Day 0 (Risk flagged >50):
- CSM triages and documents top-3 risks in ticket (JIRA- or linear ID).
- Schedule 60-min QBR with decision maker within 7 business days. Meeting owners: CSM + SE.
- Notify Renewal Manager and AE: required to join.
- Create a 90-day remediation plan with clear milestones and owners.

Mitigation options (pick and justify):
- Targeted enablement (2 half-day sessions) — owner: SE
- Product roadmap commitment (minor feature deliverable within 30 days) — owner: PM (requires Product sign-off)
- Prioritized bug fix with hotpatch — owner: Engineering on-call (request via SRE triage)
- Temporary seat credit or prorated extension (commercial) — owner: AE + Revenue Ops
- Dedicated concierge onboarding hours — owner: PS/Services

Red (exec escalation runbook):
Immediate (within 72 hours):
- Stand-up task force: CSM (owner), Renewal Manager (facilitator), AE, Head of PS, Product Manager (if product issue), SE lead, Finance rep if concessions required.
- Exec-to-Exec sync scheduled within 5 business days. Prepare one-slide "impact & request" summary (1 page: problem, customer impact, ask, success criteria, cost).
- Present at weekly "renewal fireline" meeting (Tuesdays 10am PT) for prioritization.

Commercial plays matrix (use only after ROI analysis):
- Short extension (30 days) — low cost, often buys time for technical fixes.
- Temporary discount vs usage for first renewal period — used sparingly for strategic customers.
- Credits for missed SLAs — apply when platform issues correlate to churn signal.
- Bundled professional services (paid or discounted) — focus on unlocking value.

Communication templates (copy-paste drafts):
- Initial CSM outreach (for Amber/Orange):
  Subject: 30-minute check — quick sync on usage and plan to reach outcomes
  Hi <Name>,
  Quick note — we’ve noticed some changes in usage for your team and want to ensure you’re getting full value. Could we schedule a 30-minute call next week to review adoption and any blockers? I’ll bring an adoption dashboard and a short plan for next steps.
  Thanks,
  <CSM name>

- Exec Escalation invite: short slide summary required. Use template: one-page "Problem & Ask" + appendix: metrics and ticket list.

Operational playbook items (CS Ops / Console):
- Dashboard: add "Renewal Risk" column to renewals view with risk score, last touch, next action, and last exec contact date.
- Alerts: auto-flag accounts entering Orange/Red — email to renewal-manager@redwood.ai and slack #renewal-alerts.
- QBR Kit: one-click pack for CSMs with usage charts, support timeline, ROI delta, and suggested playbook recommended actions.

RACI (recommended):
- CSM: owner of health diagnosis, first outreach, remediation plan owner.
- Renewal Manager: facilitator, escalation coordinator, contract negotiation lead.
- AE: commercial approvals, concessions, exec contacts.
- SE: technical remediation, enablement sessions.
- PM/Product: roadmap commitments and scope decisions.

KPIs to track after intervention (examples):
- Delta in active seats or token consumption (30/60/90d).
- Number of blockers resolved (tickets closed, sev1 count).
- Customer-reported satisfaction (post-intervention CSAT).
- Forecasted renewal ARR movement (up/down).

Suggested timeline buckets (operational cadence):
- T-120: baseline scoring and early outreach for Amber+
- T-90: standard renewal outreach for Green
- T-60: evaluate Amber -> escalate to Orange if no adoption progress
- T-30: Orange -> Red review and commercial trigger thresholds
- T-7: Finalize exec ask and formal concessions paperwork

Template checklist for CSM (tickbox style language for quick copy into Drive):
- [ ] Add risk score and notes into Console
- [ ] Send initial outreach (copy saved template)
- [ ] Book QBR / remediation meeting
- [ ] Create JIRA ticket for any product/engineering blockers
- [ ] Draft remediation timeline + owners
- [ ] If no progress by T-30, notify Renewal Manager

Notes & open questions (working):
- Need final sign-off on signal weights from Head of CS and Analytics.
- Confirm whether seat overage should be penalized more aggressively for committed enterprise deals.
- Decide if we offer a standard "90-day technical concierge" SKU for at-risk renewals.

Appendix: example case study (anonymized):
- Account: Acme Retail — initial risk 62 (Orange). Key issues: low adoption of embeddings pipeline, sev2 latency bug, decreased exec engagement. Actions taken: SE triage + 2 enablement sessions, 30-day credit + pilot extension. Outcome: adoption up 48% at 60 days; renewal converted with no permanent discount.

Next steps for reviewers:
- Review signal weights and comment in Confluence page linked above.
- Try heatmap export in Console beta and report anomalies by March 10.
- Approve a single "commercial concessions" approval flow to be added to RevOps playbook.

---
Draft notes (raw):
- keep this under CSM templates v2 folder; feel free to shred and recompose.
- quick wins: make auto-alert thresholds configurable per segment (SMB vs Enterprise).
- low-lift: add an "ask" section to renewal emails so execs see a single CTA.
